text:
"On Election Day, families have the opportunity to spend time together as a holiday, where various stores and companies offer enticing deals and discounts to attract voters. To make your decision easier, we've compiled a list of the hottest deals, fun activities, and interesting events - after fulfilling your civic duty on Tuesday, you can enjoy these offerings. Shopping malls - The Azrieli Group of Malls will offer a variety of products from different brands for only 17 NIS. Some of the participating stores include Delta, Zip, H&O, Carbite, Honeyman, TNT, Vardinon, and Body Shop. - The Seven Stars Mall in Herzliya will offer a free day of activities, including a show by Guy Friedman, a sweet workshop, and a cooking workshop for children. - The Renanim Mall in Ra'anana will have a large, free area with real snow from Mount Hermon, available from the beginning of the day until the end. Children can build snowmen, take pictures, and even ski, almost like in the real ski resort. - The Savion Mall will host a second-hand goods market, where children will sell their old toys. Admission is free. - The Afula Mall, part of the Afula Mall Group, will feature a 5:30 PM performance of the children's show "Lili and Shlomtzion" with some of the beloved and well-known songs of the late poet Naomi Shemer. - The Hadar Mall in Jerusalem will host a Naomi Shemer-themed festival, where children can enjoy various activities and games." Anyone who spends at least 99 NIS and above at the mall stores will have the opportunity to spin the wheel and win attractive prizes at various stores.

At the G Mall in Kfar Saba, a 11 a.m. show by popular children's entertainer Michal Haktana will take place.

Group Big Centers is offering special deals at all 16 of their centers. Fashion - Castro is offering a second pair of jeans for 50% off from their new denim collection for women and men. Castro's denim collection starts at 169.90 NIS.

ZIP is offering 50% off skirts, jeans, and pants from their Spring/Summer 2015 collection.

Ronen Chen's store is offering 100 NIS off when purchasing two items from their Spring/Summer collection.

At ML stores, customers can get a second item for 20 NIS. Additionally, anyone who shows a photo of themselves voting at the polls will receive a gift. - At 54 Factory, the Spring/Summer 2015 collection of high-end designer and brand clothing will be on sale for 18% off. - Skechers is offering 35% off all items and 40% off their Winter collection. - Crazy Line, a fashion brand, is offering 30% off their Spring/Summer 2015 collection. - Bagir is offering blazers for 399 NIS and 50% off ties and shirts. - The clothing retailer, Celio, is offering a second shirt for half the price. - All types of office chairs and computer chairs at Harmony Home are on sale for 149.90 NIS each. - Jack Kuba, a lingerie brand, is offering 30% off their Spring/Summer 2015 collection. - The clothing retailer, Onot, is offering 30% off their new collection. - The clothing retailer, Jump, is offering a buy one, get one free deal in their stores. - Purchase 350 shekels or more at Golf Kids and Golf & Co. and pay only 250 shekels. - Buy 300 shekels at Kitan and pay only 200 shekels. - Adika, an online shopping platform, is offering 20% off select items. - Sporting goods retailer 'Vertaimer Sport' is offering 25% off athletic shoes, moisture-wicking shirts, tights, sports bras, and more. - Children's shoe store 'Nimrod' is offering ballet flats and sneakers for boys and girls at 99.90 shekels. - Select 'Selket' stores are offering Havaianas flip-flops for women at 29.90 shekels with every purchase of 100 shekels. - Mattress retailer 'Good Night' is offering a trade-in deal for all products in their store, up to 2,000 shekels off, at all 14 locations. - Electronics retailers 'Good Night' and 'Shakam Electronics' are offering a 30% discount on over 50 popular home appliances from all major brands. - Carpet and rug retailer 'Tzemer Carpets' is offering 20-50% off all rugs. - American Comfort and Amican Center are offering a 'Tax-Free Day' sale." - Bitelee is offering free delivery and installation on all purchases, and a free flooring installation with the purchase of flooring. - IDdesign is offering 50% off the second item on all furniture, rugs, and home decor. - Home Center is offering a 50% discount on any purchase of $300 or more on select home goods, textiles, and bathroom accessories. - Lomatayl is offering a 20% discount on camping and travel gear for purchases over $300. - Shamart Hazor is offering a 50% discount on the more expensive item when you buy one piece of furniture. - Skyline-Sany Communications, Samsung's distributor in Israel, will offer attractive prices on various Samsung Galaxy models. - Newpan is hosting a special sale at their outlet stores, offering up to 60% off select home appliances and kitchenware from their showroom and overstock. - In the Hertzel Street complex in Rishon LeZion, the election results will be displayed on all the bars in the area." At the Laviit coffee chain, anyone who votes will receive a free cup of coffee. Hamat Gader will offer a 25% discount for visitors to their site. The Mashbir department store is offering 20% off all items, in addition to existing discounts. Laline is offering 30% off for members and new sign-ups, or three items for 99 NIS. BurgerBar is offering a free side dish with any meal (fries, onion rings, or a personal salad). Energy Sports, a fitness center, pool, and spa, will provide free entry and full use of their facilities and pool from 8 AM to 6 PM. Zoos Sport, a fitness club, will offer free entry and full use of their facilities and pool from 8 AM to 6 PM"
claim: Hamat Gader will not offer a 25% discount for visitors to their site.
label: INCORRECT
